messages:
Carlos (Customer): Hi — our org sees EU region filtered in Console, but charts still show US traffic. We pinned region=eu and model=rwd-3b, yet token counts are zero while API logs show activity. Can someone help?

Jamie (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste repro steps and which dashboard/view you used? Screenshots help too.

Carlos (Customer): Steps: 1) Console > Analytics > Model usage 2) Region dropdown -> EU (fr-par) 3) Model -> rwd-3b 4) 30d range. Screenshot: https://example.com/snap1.png. API logs (sample):
```
POST /v1/generate 200
{"model":"rwd-3b","region":"eu","tokens":124}
```
But dashboard shows 0 tokens and a big lump in US region.

Jamie (Support): Thanks. Sending to eng for quick triage. @Arjun @Evan can you take a look? :eyes:

Arjun (SRE): I can try to reproduce. Two quick Qs: are you using an org-level filter or personal view? Any ad hoc aliasing for model names (e.g., rwd-3b -> rwd-3b-q4)?

Carlos (Customer): Org-level default set to EU. No model aliasing on our side. We pin exact model id.

Evan (Analytics): I pulled the backend query using the dashboard's filters — the filter translation looked off: region filter was serialized as `region: ["eu"]` but the backend ingestion tags are `region: "eu-fr"` (full zone). That mismatch would cause drop-through. Sending the translated query:
```
GET /internal/usage?region=eu&model=rwd-3b
```
But the stored events have `region=eu-fr` and `model_alias=rwd-3b`.

Maya (Product): Could be the UI normalizer that maps short region codes -> zones. We had a recent change to allow shorthand (eu -> eu-fr, eu-de) and a corner case where selecting a single shorthand did not expand to the exact zone list.

Arjun (SRE): Repro steps from my side: 1) Load /analytics/models 2) Select region: eu (single-select) 3) Select model: rwd-3b 4) Observe tokens=0 and a separate US bucket. I captured the frontend->backend payload:
```
{"filters":{"region":["eu"],"model":["rwd-3b"]}}
```
Backend expects `region_zone` or full zone names. So backend query returns zero rows.

Jamie (Support): Next steps? Customer impact: Carlos reporting missing billing tokens and alerting finance.

Evan (Analytics): Short-term workaround: in Console manual select the full zone (eu-fr) instead of eu shorthand — that will show data. Medium-term: fix normalizer to expand single shorthand into all matching zones.

Maya (Product): I'll open a bug and prioritize as P1 for analytics filters mismatch. Need owner for patch + frontend release. Acceptance criteria: selecting shorthand region should expand to matching zones OR UI should persist full-zone selection.

Arjun (SRE): I can do a hotfix to the backend to treat `region: eu` as wildcard expansion for query translation for the next hour while a proper release is prepared. Will push a small mapping in feature-flagged path.

DeployBot: deploy started: analytics-filter-hotfix -> canary -> 3 nodes

Carlos (Customer): Appreciate the quick response. Will try the workaround meanwhile.

Jamie (Support): Carlos, can you confirm if you saw any billing discrepancy? We want to ensure invoices are correct.

Carlos (Customer): Finance saw underreporting for the last 48h; they put a hold on reconciliation. If hotfix restores numbers we can re-run.

Arjun (SRE): Hotfix rolled to canary. Please check dashboard in ~5m.

DeployBot: deploy succeeded: analytics-filter-hotfix canary -> 1/1 healthy

Evan (Analytics): Confirming — after hotfix, console queries with region=eu now translate to `region_zone IN ("eu-fr","eu-de")` and charts populated for Carlos' org.

Carlos (Customer): I can see numbers now! Tokens match API logs. Thank you. :raised_hands:

Maya (Product): Creating full PR to update UI normalizer and adding unit tests for single vs multi-select paths. Also adding a migration to backfill dashboards that stored shorthand filters.

Jamie (Support): Marking as monitored. Will follow up with Carlos tomorrow to confirm billing reconciliation. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Arjun (SRE): Follow-up note: root cause was a regression in the filter serialization library introduced in commit `f2a9b3e` — it changed single-select handling. Patch/rollback applied. I'll add a post-deploy validation check for filter expansions.

Carlos (Customer): All good on our side. We'll reopen if anything else crops up.
